# Grand Bend Heating & Cooling

> Grand Bend Heating & Cooling provides heating and cooling service to homeowners in and around Grand Bend, Lambton County, Ontario. The team handles furnace and AC repair, ductless mini-split installation, heat pump service, gas fireplace work, thermostat upgrades, and duct cleaning.

Phone: (548) 554-3151  |  Email: contact@grandbendheatingcooling.ca  |  Website: https://grandbendheatingcooling.ca

Service areas: Grand Bend, Port Franks, Thedford, Parkhill, Forest
